title: New exercises added to the library reach only new installs unless someone remembers to raise one number by hand
what: A fresh install gets the whole exercise library. A phone that updates only gets new exercises and new names when the library's version number was raised in that release. Nothing checks that the number was raised when exercises were added or renamed, so a forgotten bump leaves every existing member without the new exercises while new members have them.
expected: Every update that changes the library reaches every existing phone, and a check fails the build when the library changes without the version moving.
how_often: each release that adds or renames exercises
fix_line: Add a test that pins a fingerprint of the library to its version number, so a change without a bump fails

title: A workout left open for weeks still says 'Workout in progress' with no date
what: A member who started a workout and never finished it, then comes back weeks or months later, sees 'Workout in progress' with Resume and Discard. The card never says when that workout was started, so it looks like something from today.
expected: The card says when the open workout was started once it is not from today (for example 'Started 3 Mar'), so the member can decide to finish or discard it.
fix_line: Pass the start day into the card and show it when it is not today

title: Photos a year or more apart read as '400 days apart' or '104 weeks apart'
what: The gap between two progress photos is only ever said in days or weeks. Photos a year apart show '365 days apart' or '52 weeks apart'; two years apart, '104 weeks apart'. This is also the big title of the shared before and after picture.
expected: Long gaps read in months or years ('1 year apart', '14 months apart').
how_often: every pair over a few months apart
fix_line: Say months past about 8 weeks and years past 12 months

items.reason: Library update on launch is version-gated and stamped only after the write succeeds; a restore forgets the stamp first and re-syncs; pictures are bundled, no download cache. Watch, sideload vs Play package and panel cache: this area holds no watch, package or web code.

Gym closes or member leaves: gym folders relabelled 'No longer sent', and come back on return. Year end and leap day: month and week maths use calendar dates, dates from another year show the year, share pictures always carry the year. 6 months away: lighter start after a break, but the Profile goal ignores it (existing finding) and an old open workout shows no date. Trial end, plan end, staff leaves: not in this area.
The existing-phone path is the version-gated re-sync (links, renames, inserts); it works only when the version is raised.

No dots, What's new or update notices in this area. The first-routine guide shows to any member with no routines, including long-time loggers after an update. The target 'i' stands out per reason, not per version.
